Messages.Body: Convert seems kind of useless here. Can only use the decrypt special with three vampires in the crypt (one of those being the other copy of itself). Doesn't fell like a great way to improve the crypt draw. Why not Rayne or Ruslan as a second weenie, if you want to have weenies in the crypt?
